source_text:
ἐφώτισεν τὴν ἀνθρωπότητα διὰ τῶν ἐντολῶν τοῦ νόμου τὸ ἀληθινὸν φῶς ὁ Θεὸς
ἡμῶν.
Ἡ ἐντολὴ γὰρ Κυρίου τηλαυγὴς φωτίζουσα ὀφθαλμούς. Καὶ πάλιν, ὅτι Φῶς
τὰ προστάγματά σου. Ἀπὸ ἕκτης ὥρας, τὸ ἥμισυ τῆς ἡμέρας· ὅτε γὰρ ἐμέσασαν οἱ
χρόνοι οἱ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς κτίσεως, καὶ ἕως συντελείας, τότε μεσημβρινὸν ἀπεστάλη
Μωϋσῆς καὶ Ἀαρών. Καὶ γὰρ ἡ κατὰ νόμον λατρεία, ἕως ὀγδόης· ἐννάτη δὲ ὥρα,
καιρὸς τῶν πνευματοφόρων προφητῶν· καὶ γὰρ αὐτοὶ ὡς καλοὶ ἐργάται
ἀπεστάλησαν παρὰ τοῦ οἰκοδεσπότου ἐργάσασθαι τὸν ἀμπελῶνα τῆς ψυχῆς ἡμῶν
ἕως δεκάτης. Ἑνδεκάτη ὥρα, ἐπιδημία τοῦ Μονογενοῦς· ἐπ' ἐσχάτων γὰρ τῶν
χρόνων ἐπὶ συντελείᾳ τῶν αἰώνων ἐπεδήμησεν ἡμῖν ὁ τοῦ Θεοῦ Υἱὸς, Θεοῦ Λόγος·
ὥσπερ γὰρ ἀπὸ ἑνδεκάτης εἰς δωδεκάτην ἄλλη μία ὥρα ἐστὶν ἡ ἐσχάτη, οὕτως ἀπὸ
τῆς ἐπιδημίας Χριστοῦ ἕως τῆς συντελείας, ἄλλη μία ὥρα ἐστίν.
thought_title: The midday law and the prophets before the coming of the only Son
orientation: Cyril is still counting the hours of the parable, moving from the time of the law through the prophets to the coming of Christ as the eleventh hour.
pass_a_gloss: Our God, the true light, gave light to humanity through the commandments of the law. For the commandment of the Lord is shining from afar, giving light to eyes. And again, that your ordinances are light. From the sixth hour, the half of the day. For when the times from the beginning of creation and until the completion came to the middle, then at midday Moses and Aaron were sent. For also the worship according to the law lasted until the eighth. But the ninth hour is the time of the prophets who carry the Spirit. For they also, as good laborers, were sent by the landowner to work the vineyard of our soul until the tenth. The eleventh hour is the coming of the only Son. For in the last of the times, at the completion of the ages, the Son of God, the Word of God, came to us. For just as from the eleventh to the twelfth there is one other hour, the last one, so from the coming of Christ until the completion there is one other hour.

bible_refs.note: Ἡ ἐντολὴ Κυρίου τηλαυγὴς φωτίζουσα ὀφθαλμούς

pass_b_english: for truly our God, the true light, enlightened humanity through the commandments of the law. For "the commandment of the Lord is clear, and it gives light to the eyes" (Psalms 19:8). And again, "your ordinances are light."

From the sixth hour begins the second half of the day. For the years from the beginning of creation to its fulfillment had reached their midpoint. Then Moses and Aaron were sent at midday. Worship under the law lasted until the eighth hour. The ninth hour is the time of the Spirit-bearing prophets. They too were sent as good laborers by the landowner to work the vineyard of our soul. They worked until the tenth hour.

The eleventh hour is the coming of the only Son. For in the last days, at the fulfillment of the ages, the Son of God came to us, the Word of God. As one last hour runs from the eleventh to the twelfth, so one hour runs from the coming of Christ to the fulfillment.

last_rejected.source_quote: ὅτε γὰρ ἐμέσασαν οἱ χρόνοι οἱ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς κτίσεως, καὶ ἕως συντελείας
last_rejected.why: The source says the times from creation to the consummation reached their midpoint. The English writes 'to its fulfillment', which leaves the referent vague, and 'years' is a loose rendering of χρόνοι (times).
last_rejected.fix: For when the times from the beginning of creation to the consummation had reached their midpoint, then Moses and Aaron were sent at midday.
last_rejected.ruling: χρόνοι can mean ages or years; ἐμέσασαν and ἕως συντελείας still give the midpoint to the end.

last_rejected.quote: As one last hour runs from the eleventh to the twelfth, so one hour runs from the coming of Christ to the fulfillment.
last_rejected.source_quote: ἄλλη μία ὥρα ἐστὶν ἡ ἐσχάτη, οὕτως ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπιδημίας Χριστοῦ ἕως τῆς συντελείας, ἄλλη μία ὥρα ἐστίν
last_rejected.why: The source says the eleventh hour is followed by one more, the last hour. The English drops the sense of 'another' hour and states the parallel loosely.
last_rejected.fix: Just as from the eleventh to the twelfth there is one more hour, the last, so from Christ's coming to the consummation there is one more hour.
last_rejected.ruling: ἄλλη μία ὥρα ἡ ἐσχάτη remains one last hour from eleventh to twelfth; the parallel stands.
